title: Chemical Spill Urgent
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a chemical spill that has entered or has the potential to enter the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a chemical spill that has entered or has the potential to enter the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. Please call 311 for more information.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a chemical spill threatening a public waterway or drain.
actions.why: Report a chemical spill that entered or could enter a street, alley, ditch, creek or channel, lake, river, or storm drain or inlet. The description for "Chemical Spill Urgent" requests on the Dallas 311 website says this request must be dispatched by phone.
